research_question: Does a new 24-hour price boundary that is not confirmed by 24-hour cumulative signed taker quote flow reverse after a separately completed reclaim strongly enough to trade toward the prior auction value after twenty basis points of costs?

sources: cumulative-volume-delta divergence used in order-flow trading
reused: price and flow must be measured over a completed multi-hour state rather than the entry bar
a new price extreme without a new same-direction cumulative-flow extreme is unresolved until a later reclaim
entry, invalidation and target belong to the same failed-boundary auction

scenario.context: a completed thirty-minute bar breaches the prior completed twenty-four-hour high or low with above-median quote volume

state.FAILED_HIGH_CVD_DIVERGENCE: price makes a new high but rolling 24-hour cumulative signed taker flow does not exceed its prior 24-hour high
state.FAILED_LOW_CVD_DIVERGENCE: price makes a new low but rolling 24-hour cumulative signed taker flow does not fall below its prior 24-hour low
state.UNRESOLVED: all other boundary events are no-trade

scenario.confirmation: the next completed fifteen-minute bar closes back inside the old boundary, moves toward prior value, has a directional body and opposite taker pressure
scenario.invalidation: beyond the boundary-breach extreme plus ten percent of prior thirty-minute ATR
scenario.target: quote-volume-weighted typical price of the prior completed twenty-four-hour auction
scenario.management: target or stop first; otherwise exit after six hours
scenario.arbitration: one global open position; choose the largest normalized price-flow divergence

data.source: Binance Vision USD-M monthly and latest daily five-minute klines
data.visibility: prior boundary, prior flow extremes and prior value are shifted; current event is completed before separate confirmation

advance_gate.final_integrated_system_frequency_requir: at least one independent completed trade per calendar day

decision_contract.advance: Only a fixed divergence route positive in every declared split advances to NautilusTrader.
decision_contract.reject: Do not tune boundary, flow-divergence, confirmation, stop or value-target rules after evaluation.
